scope: Public finite Ok routes without a global certificate; unchanged certified branches are identified separately.

routes.route: held mean, free sd and nu
routes.trigger: constrained profile retained when face exclusion does not close
routes.before: profile nominations and score-gated search
routes.after: analytic observed-information Newton correction in public mean/sd/nu coordinates; held mean constant

routes.route: held sd, free mean and nu
routes.trigger: constrained profile retained when face exclusion does not close
routes.before: profile nominations and score-gated search
routes.after: analytic observed-information Newton correction with variance-standardization derivative and held sd constant

routes.route: held mean and sd, free nu fallback
routes.trigger: scalar certificate budget or comparison unresolved and old search succeeds
routes.before: legacy scalar search and score gate
routes.after: one free-coordinate Newton correction mapped from log(nu-2) to nu

routes.route: held nu, free location and scale through lst
routes.trigger: parent joint inclusion fails after EM convergence
routes.before: parent previously refused; certification flag was not transported
routes.before_contract: not a finite fallback before this job
routes.after: transport parent's uncertified accurate point, then check standardized sd including its physical-scale conversion

routes.route: held mu, free sigma and df
routes.trigger: finite constrained search retained without face exclusion
routes.before: profile nominations and score gate
routes.after: analytic Newton correction; free df uses log(df) when the location hold exempts the df>=1 restriction

routes.route: held sigma, free mu and df
routes.trigger: finite constrained search retained without a closed certificate
routes.before: profile nominations and score gate
routes.after: analytic Newton correction with sample-range location floor; natural df near one, one-sided restriction check and interior continuation

routes.route: held mu and sigma, free df fallback
routes.trigger: shape certificate cannot close and numerical search succeeds

routes.after: one free-coordinate Newton correction mapped to public df

routes.route: held df<1, free mu and sigma
routes.trigger: strict atom inequalities and no proved symmetry exclusion
routes.before: generic asymmetric samples refused without a joint search
routes.before_contract: not a finite fallback before this job
routes.after: 15 quantile/scale BFGS starts; positive-information contracting Newton step for each candidate; best checked likelihood returned uncertified

routes.route: held df>=1, free mu and sigma
routes.trigger: EM converges but joint_inclusion fails
routes.before: numerical refusal despite a converged search
routes.before_contract: not a finite fallback before this job
routes.after: retain converged point, analytic contracting Newton correction, finite physical-point likelihood witness, uncertified

unchanged_certified_branches: std and lst: all-free certificates, closed scalar certificates, included held-shape roots and proved limit/nonexistence outcomes
sstd: unit-skew all-free std certificate, dedicated held-skew and held-shape/skew location-scale certificates

sged: certificate.hpp fixed-shape/skew, weighted_shape_certificate.hpp fixed-skew/free-shape, mode_skew_certificate.hpp fixed-shape/free-moments, held_moment_certificate.hpp fixed-moments/fixed-shape, and skew_certificate.hpp/subunit_certificate.hpp dedicated shape-two or subunit fits all mark finite Ok results certified. Their false flags occur on non-Ok outcomes. The 17 inaccurate certified replay rows are preserved by instruction. GED transport in free_shape_certificate.hpp is the only delegated finite Ok exception.
st: symmetric-joint, skew-only, location-only, symmetric-scale, one-sign-scale and constant-location/skew certificates
metadata_caveat: The common sstd and st bindings omit the successful C++ certified field; slash has no certified member. JSON null means unexposed metadata, not an observed false flag. Accuracy verification conservatively includes such finite rows. Route classification above follows the C++ dispatch and result types.
